Genus ( / ˈ dʒ iː n ə s / ; pl. : genera / ˈ dʒ ɛ n ər ə / ) is a taxonomic rank above species and below family as used in the biological classification of living and fossil organisms as well as viruses . [ 1 ] In binomial nomenclature , the genus name forms the first part of the binomial species name for each species within the genus. [ 2 ]
